hero.heading: Natural Blend Series — *Realistic Grass Look* for Arizona Landscapes
hero.body: A beautiful, realistic look that closely mimics natural grass. Lead-free, pet-friendly, and backed by a 15-year warranty. Sold in standard 15-foot wide rolls.

intro.label: About the Series
intro.heading: Realistic Color, Reliable Performance
body: Our **Natural Blend Series** offers a beautiful, realistic look that closely mimics natural grass. Perfect for *light to moderate foot traffic* — front yards, side yards, and decorative landscaping where curb appeal matters most.

Both weights share the same Emerald & Lime color palette and CoolYarn fiber technology — the difference is density. Natural Blend 75 is the budget-friendly lightweight option for accents and pathways, while Natural Blend 84 adds extra fiber for residential yards that see more use.
Not sure which weight is right for your project? [Call or text us](/contact/) and we'll help you choose.

items.heading: CoolYarn Technology
items.body: Yarn shape optimizes airflow to keep surface temperatures lower under Arizona sun.

items.heading: UV-Stabilized
items.body: Resists fading from prolonged sun exposure — color stays true for years.

items.heading: Pet & Kid Safe
items.body: 100% lead-free, allergen-free, and easy to clean. Safe for the whole family.

items.heading: 15-Year Warranty
items.body: Every roll backed by a 15-year manufacturer warranty — no fine print.

items.heading: Next-Day Delivery — Guaranteed
items.body: We deliver straight to your home or job site so your project stays on schedule.

items.heading: 15-Minute Pickup
items.body: In-store loading is fast. Grab your order and get back to the job.

items.heading: Price Match Guarantee
items.body: Bring us any competitor's invoice and we'll match it. Simple as that.
